illustrates.quote: b. Dashes and Swung Dashes. Many dictionaries use the dash and/or the swung dash to replace or stand for the main entry word at certain points in the entries. Follow print for emphasis, number, and spacing of dashes.

blocks.text: stay … 6. to keep even in a contest or rivalry <~ with the leaders>
blocks.features: bold 'stay'. No thesaurus/dictionary construct (F-193) or devised-symbol mechanism exists for a swung dash standing in for the entry word inside angle brackets — recorded as not representable.

print.notes: The swung dash has a space before and after it in print.
